name: Varjota (Brazil)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a maize cob, grapes and a fish under a crest with a letter V.
history: Varjota is a municipality in the state of Ceará, Brazil. The flag was adopted in 1986 (designed in 1986 by Evandro Leal Colaço when Varjota became a municipality, according to Flags of the World citing the municipal website; the arms on the flag were modernised in 2011).

features.role: municipal arms with a maize cob, grapes and a fish under a crest with a letter V
